gloss: red ink pad, vermilion seal pad

definitions.gloss: red ink pad, vermilion seal pad
definitions.explanation: A pad containing red or vermilion ink used for stamping personal seals (hanko) in Japan.

examples.japanese: {印鑑|いんかん}を{朱肉|しゅにく}につけて{押|お}す。
examples.english: I press the seal onto the red ink pad and stamp it.

examples.japanese: {朱肉|しゅにく}の{色|いろ}が{薄|うす}くなった。
examples.english: The red ink pad has faded.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{朱肉|しゅにく}を{買|か}わないといけない。
examples.english: I need to buy a new red ink pad.

notes:
USAGE: {朱肉|しゅにく} is an essential item for using {印鑑|いんかん}/{判子|はんこ} (personal seals), which are widely used in Japan for signing documents.

TYPES:
・{練|ね}り{朱肉|しゅにく} - paste-type ink pad (traditional, higher quality)
・スポンジ{朱肉|しゅにく} - sponge-type ink pad (common for everyday use)

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{朱肉|しゅにく}をつける (to apply red ink)
・{朱肉|しゅにく}に{押|お}しつける (to press onto the ink pad)

CULTURAL NOTE: While digital signatures are becoming more common, {朱肉|しゅにく} and {印鑑|いんかん} remain important in Japanese business and legal contexts.

NOTE: The color is traditionally vermilion ({朱|しゅ}), a red-orange shade considered auspicious in East Asian cultures.
